bootstrap.scheme: Stratify by concept; resample whole clusters with replacement, retaining all families/variants/languages/models jointly.
bootstrap.point_estimand: Equal family mean inside concept/language; overall equal concept/language mean.
bootstrap.unequal_cluster_rule: Sum resampled cluster family totals / sum resampled family counts, not unweighted cluster means.
bootstrap.interval: Descriptive percentile95%; conditional fixed renderer/source frame/model collection; not a simultaneous CI.

limitations: No new hypothesis tests or changes to the four-claim family.
Conditional capability flags do not pass the original template/generalization/power gate.
Convenience source records and shared institutions may remain dependent beyond recorded graph edges.
Sixteen variants are repeated measurements, not sixteen independent sources.
A passing controlled-record task does not establish broad semantic or natural-language competence.
